item.title: Version 3.2.1
item.description:
Installing a new version used to stick it in a new folder by version which meant the older version was never replaced; this is now fixed.

On a display set to 125% or 150%, the bottom of the page tabs was cut off ([#108](https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/issues/108)). The tab strip was measured at startup at whatever scale it started on and then would fail if the DPI changed. It now re-measures when the scale changes.

Administrators turning update checks off for a managed deployment now are able to check if the setting applied with `CedarLogic.exe --update-status`. The registry keys have also been tweaked to work with both 64 bit and 32 bit keys and be a bit more permissive in what values are accepted.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1
